description: Climate Resilience Evaluation & Awareness Tool (CREAT) is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by EPA Office of Ground Water and Drinking Water, Water Security Division. Water sector utilities can use this tool to help them consider how events such as sea level rise, shifting precipitation patterns, temperature changes, and extreme weather may impact their assets and operations. The tool presents five modules to help users consider climate impacts and identify adaptation options to increase resilience. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought, Extreme Cold, Extreme Heat, Water Quality. Assets: Water Infrastructure – Drinking Water, Water Infrastructure – General, Water Infrastructure – Wastewater. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
